functions.name: edit_message
functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.edit_message(p_id bigint, p_body text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if char_length(trim(coalesce(p_body, ''))) = 0 then return false; end if;
  update chat_messages set body = left(p_body, 4000), edited_at = now()
    where id = p_id and sender = auth.uid() and deleted_at is null;
  return found;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.revoke_invite(p_id bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  update chat_invites set revoked = true where id = p_id and (created_by = auth.uid() or is_owner());
  return found;
end
$function$

functions.name: set_bot_note
functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_bot_note(p_note text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if not is_owner() then return false; end if;
  update chat_settings set bot_note = left(nullif(trim(p_note), ''), 1000) where id = 1;
  return found;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_owner()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (select 1 from chat_members where user_id = auth.uid() and role = 'owner')
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.delete_message(p_id bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  update chat_messages set body = '', file_path = null, file_name = null, file_size = null, file_type = null, deleted_at = now()
    where id = p_id and (sender = auth.uid() or is_owner()) and deleted_at is null;
  return found;
end
$function$

functions.name: list_members
functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_members()
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, joined_at timestamp with time zone, role text, invited_by uuid, invite_id bigint, message_count bigint, file_count bigint, reaction_count bigint, last_message_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select m.user_id, m.joined_at, m.role, m.invited_by, m.invite_id,
    (select count(*) from chat_messages c where c.sender = m.user_id and c.deleted_at is null),
    (select count(*) from chat_messages c where c.sender = m.user_id and c.file_path is not null),
    (select count(*) from chat_reactions r where r.user_id = m.user_id),
    (select max(c.created_at) from chat_messages c where c.sender = m.user_id)
  from chat_members m
  where exists (select 1 from chat_members x where x.user_id = auth.uid())
  order by m.joined_at
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_bot_note()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select case when is_owner() then (select bot_note from chat_settings where id = 1) end
$function$

functions.name: notify_push
functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notify_push()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  perform net.http_post(
    url := 'https://kat-chat-flame.vercel.app/api/push',
    body := jsonb_build_object('id', new.id),
    headers := '{"Content-Type": "application/json"}'::jsonb
  );
  return new;
end
$function$
